per_view.notes: Front upper-deck hump present and slender tube with rounded nose, upswept tail, and tall swept fin. Engines are a merged blocky cluster under the wing root, count unclear, not four separated underslung nacelles. Two-deck dashed window lines and cockpit hints visible. Nose gear plus wheels under engine mass. Flat monochrome grey livery, no accent.

Slender grey tube with rounded nose (right), front-third upper-deck hump with its own window row, and a main-deck window line. Tall swept vertical fin but no visible horizontal stabilizer. Engines are a clustered blob mid-fuselage under a thin flat swept wing, not four spaced nacelles. Single nose strut and small wheels; wing reads as a flat line without taper or dihedral.

Four nacelles hung under swept wings, two per side, correct count. Rounded bulbous fuselage with a small raised cockpit/upper-lobe region; hump barely reads head-on. Thin vertical fin at crown; horizontal stabilizers not distinguishable. Nose and a couple main-gear struts with wheels present. Only a dark cockpit windshield; no passenger window line. Coherent light-grey monochrome livery, clean ass

Rear head-on: tall swept vertical fin present but no horizontal stabilizers visible at the tail. Four engine nacelles on pylons under swept, dihedral, tapering wings, good spacing. Main-gear wheel trucks under the body. Uniform grey monochrome, no white/grey contrast or accents. Fuselage seen end-on as a circle; hump, body length, and windows not assessable from this angle. Clean assembly, no floa

Four cylindrical engine shapes, two per wing, but they sit atop/float above the wing surface rather than hanging on underslung pylons ahead of the leading edge. Slender tapered fuselage, well-swept tapering wings, swept horizontal stabilizers and a thin central fin present. Dashed centerline and an oval cockpit region provide faint detail. Flat monochrome grey livery; no hump readable from top.

Slender tapering fuselage with clean nose and upswept tail, single swept fin. Four nacelles present but the far-wing pair sits high near the rear fuselage looking awkwardly placed. Consistent main-deck window band. No upper-deck hump at all, so silhouette reads generic four-engine, not specifically 747. Only a tiny nose gear visible; coherent grey/white livery.

Slender white fuselage with tapering tail cone and rounded nose. Distinct front upper-deck hump with window row. Swept wings with mild taper. Vertical fin plus swept horizontal stabilizers at tail. Main-deck window line present. Engines appear as a bunched cluster near the wing root rather than four spread underslung nacelles; small dark gear/pylon shapes look floating and crowded.

Slender grey tube with rounded nose, tapering tail cone, and a subtle front hump. Swept but flat thin wings, minimal dihedral. Window/door dashes and cockpit windows present. Tall dark fin plus horizontal stabilizers. Under-wing region is a cluttered jumble of nacelle-like cylinders and dark wheel clusters, floating and hard to resolve as four underslung engines; nose gear visible.

Slender tapering fuselage with rounded nose; partial upper-deck hump present at front third. Multiple nacelles cluster tightly near the wing root rather than spread inboard/outboard, spacing cramped and pylons stubby. Consistent main-deck window dots, cockpit windows faint. Small nose gear visible. Flat uniform grey clay, no livery. Tall swept fin present.

critic.fix_suggestion: Improve 'Landing gear (nose gear + 4-truck main gear) when visible' (mean 4.88/10). Target the 8 anchor: nose gear plus four main-gear trucks under the wing/body junction with wheels; then the 10 anchor: recognizable 747 gear layout: two-wheel nose strut, four multi-wheel main bogies (two under the body, two under the wings), plausible strut lengths.
